findings.title: Category Precedence Inversion in FaqFooter handleEnquirySubmit
findings.observation: In FaqFooter.tsx line 86: `*Category:* ${formData.category || selectedCategory}`. When a user selects a Business Card variant from the gallery, EnquiryContext updates selectedCategory to "Business Cards". However, because formData.category was initialized to "Review Solutions" and is truthy, formData.category takes precedence over selectedCategory in the submitted message.
findings.logicChain:
1. FaqFooter initializes formData.category with default "Review Solutions"
2. User clicks "Onyx Black" card in GalleryCustom.tsx
3. handleSelect calls setSelectedVariant("Onyx Black", "Business Cards")
4. Context updates selectedCategory to "Business Cards"
5. User submits form without clicking category tab buttons
6. Expression `formData.category || selectedCategory` evaluates to "Review Solutions"
7. Result: WhatsApp enquiry says "*Category:* Review Solutions" with "*Selected Variant:* Onyx Black".
findings.impact: Submitted WhatsApp payload reports "Review Solutions" category for business card products unless the user explicitly clicks the "Business Cards" category pill on the form.
findings.recommendation: Update line 86 in FaqFooter.tsx to `${selectedCategory || formData.category}` matching the pattern used for selectedVariant line 85 `${selectedVariant || formData.selectedVariant}`, or sync formData.category via useEffect when selectedCategory changes.
